detail.longDescription: Years ago (2015-2020) I created a few hobby projects. The setup was extremely simple via: tiangolo/uwsgi-nginx-flask:latest docker image, a slim docker image with a production ready webserver simple requirements from /app/requirements.txt which were installed via pip in the Docker file a prestart.sh which did some flask database migrations if necessary It was of good performance due to having nginx. I had an ansible script which build the docker image, made a local tarbar with docke save , send it over to my VPS and ran the image at specified domain. With Traefik, I could ran dozens of projects on a single VPS. Now I coded a new app and got from one problem into the other, all due to deprecated software. I was using Flask 2.0, uWSGI (which is deprecated) on a Debian bullseye image (also, deprecated). I couldn't even install a sqlite client in the container because every package got a 404 LOL. Can someone give me a few hints into best practices nowadays, which will be maintainable for the next few years? I am not professionally coding anymore but would like to keep as close to my current setup.
